# Final activation runbook - 50 playable / 50 locked games, owner access to all 100, NO account cap

**Rule:** the activation release has the 50-game lock COMPILED IN. Deploying it IS the activation. It is therefore built and staged, and deployed only after the owner has the client's WRITTEN acknowledgment (CLIENT_ACKNOWLEDGMENT_DRAFT.md) or the signed agreement is verified to authorize the limitation. A verbal agreement reported by the owner is not enough on its own.

## Configuration (generated by `scripts/qa/apply-activation-policy.mjs` from PROPOSED_GAME_ALLOCATION.json)
* **Clients:** 50 playable, 50 locked; Wild Panther playable, Color Game Pro locked. Notice: "Game Locked. Please settle the remaining project payment to activate this game."
* **No account cap.** `clientAccounts.enforcement` is `off`. Clients can create staff and player accounts within their normal role permissions. The "Account Limit Reached" notice is never shown. Do NOT run `scripts/dev/activate-restrictions.mjs --enforce yes`: the database-layer flag `account_limits.enforced` must stay `no` (it is `no` today).
* **Owner:** the named account `uat_owner` (only while its role is superadmin; compiled in, not editable at runtime) has full access to all 100 games: lobby QA mode, plays locked games with synthetic credits (it may credit itself on the UAT only, ledgered and audited), configures/enables/disables any game, bulk configuration over all 100. Owner QA never unlocks anything for clients (tested).
* **Client administrators** (`client_admin01`, `client_admin02`, 0 credits): superadmin-tier accounts that are NOT the owner. They can create staff and player accounts, manage synthetic credits within the normal rules and configure the 50 playable games; they cannot play or activate a locked game (API or bulk), cannot apply grants (no signing key exists), cannot modify the owner account (profile, role, balance, lock, sessions) and cannot create an account named like the owner. A staff-tier `admin` account can only create players (existing rule).
* `grantKeys` is empty: unlocking the 50 games requires a new verified release after payment.
* Choice recorded: game configuration is superadmin-only in this system, and only superadmins can create staff accounts, so client administrators must be superadmin-tier. `create-client-staff.mjs --role admin` creates plain staff accounts instead (no game configuration).

## Order of events
1. (assistant, done when this file is committed) Build + CI + artifact verification + kit pins + test evidence.
2. (owner) Send CLIENT_ACKNOWLEDGMENT_DRAFT.md; store the client's written reply. Tell the assistant "acknowledgment received".
3. (owner, sudo) the same three runs as the previous deployment: extract + plan, fresh trigger-aware backup (R2) + Windows drill, apply/switch script (automatic rollback to the previous release if health fails). No database migration is pending for this release; the switch script reports nothing to apply.
4. (assistant) `node scripts/qa/verify-activation.mjs`: client sees exactly 50 locked / 50 playable; owner sees all 100; no limit notice.
5. (assistant) `node scripts/qa/create-client-staff.mjs --apply` (random temporary passwords into a local file, never printed), then ledger reconciliation (owner sudo, read-only script) and browser checks.
6. (owner) fill the 7-day dates in CLIENT_TESTING_HANDOVER.md, deliver the URL and each login through separate channels, remind the client of the PHP 50,000 balance.

## Rollback
Reinstall `uat-run.rollback-<previous sha>.mjs` and restart `maxhigh-uat` (all earlier releases stay on the VPS). Database changes are additive; never restore over UAT, restore into the isolated check schema and compare.
